outputs.exact_statement:
For every $0<\gamma<\gamma_*$, there is an integer $Q_\gamma$ such that for every integer $Q\ge Q_\gamma$, $$\label{eq:architecture}
 H_Q^2\ge\gamma H_Q\qquad\text{on }\mathcal F_Q.$$ The threshold $Q_\gamma$ is independent of particle number.

Suppose $j_1,j_2\to\infty$ and $j_2/(j_1+j_2)\to u^2$, where $0<u<1$. Put $v=\sqrt{1-u^2}$. For fixed integers $0\le z\le T$, the normalized coupled vector of spin $j_1+j_2-z$ at total lowering deficit $T$ can be chosen with real coefficients converging to the coefficients $s^{(u)}_{z,T,p}$ of $$\label{eq:coupling}
 \frac{(uX-vY)^z(vX+uY)^{T-z}}{\sqrt{z!(T-z)!}}.$$ Descendants in every copy are obtained by normalized lowering, so the matching of bases between equal-spin copies is intertwining.
For $N\ge2$ and $Q=3(N-1)$, the kernel of $H_{N,Q}$ is the line spanned by $\Psi_{\mathrm L,N}$.

For $N\ge2$, fix $Q_N=3(N-1)$ and write $E_0(n;Q_N)=\min\operatorname{spec}H_{n,Q_N}$ for the coefficient-one interaction [eq:physicalH]. Let $\operatorname{Gap}_N$ be the first positive eigenvalue of $H_{N,Q_N}$, its neutral gap. The particle-number charge gap at this same flux, $$\Delta_N=E_0(N+1;Q_N)+E_0(N-1;Q_N)-2E_0(N;Q_N),$$ satisfies $$\Delta_N=E_0(N+1;Q_N) \ge\frac{N}{N-1}\operatorname{Gap}_N>0.$$ In particular, $\Delta_N\ge N/[25(N-1)]$ for $N\ge N_0$, with $N_0$ as in Corollary 2.

For every $N\ge2$, the untruncated planar Hamiltonian satisfies $$(H_N^{\mathrm{pl}})^2\ge\gamma_* H_N^{\mathrm{pl}},$$ where $\gamma_*$ is the constant in Theorem 1. Equivalently, if $P_{0,N}^{\mathrm{pl}}$ projects onto its kernel, then $H_N^{\mathrm{pl}}\ge\gamma_*(I-P_{0,N}^{\mathrm{pl}})$. The constant is independent of both particle number and total angular momentum. In particular, the case $\ell=3$ of the spectral gap conjecture in (Rougerie 2018--2019, Conjecture A.1) [[Rougerie](#ref-Rougerie)] holds, in its pair-projector normalization.
